Kim / Team —

Quick assessment from finance:
- Credit: BlueBay's size and public filings look reasonable; credit_app_bluebay.xlsx shows healthy cash flows but procurement cycles are long. We can accept Net-60 for the first invoice only if: PO is received prior to invoicing AND we have ACH or wire details on file.
- Exposure: Net-60 on a ~120k invoice is within our tolerance with those conditions. No deposit required if PO + ACH confirmed.
- Revenue recognition: billing quarterly vs monthly doesn't materially change ARR recognition for subscription; revenue will be recognized upon invoicing as usual (rev rec will note the larger invoice chunks). Commission timing: Sales commissions triggered on invoice receipt per policy — sales should expect a one-time timing shift for the first invoice.

Counterpoints / asks for sales:
- Require a PO and explicit procurement acknowledgment of payment timing. If PO not forthcoming we should ask for a 10% deposit.
- Include standard late-fee/interest clause (already requested).

Assuming PO + ACH, finance is OK with Net-60 first invoice and quarterly invoicing thereafter. 3% one-time credit is acceptable commercially (impact limited).
